sources.name: HSAC Haryana cadastral map — Rohtak district
sources.scope: Khasra (field) parcels of Rohtak district on the Haryana Space Applications Centre's cadastral map, with the khasra number and village shown. References are derived from each outline: a khasra can be drawn as several pieces, and joining them by key took several requests per map cell. Unnumbered (khasra 0) polygons are excluded: they cover village settlements and urban cores that the field survey does not divide, so older town centres show no parcels.

sources.licenceNote: No reuse licence is stated on the public HSAC map service.
caveats: Rural field-survey parcels: not proof of current title or ownership.

Application identity is the outline hash (geometry-sha256-v1); the published uq key (district//tehsil//village//murabba//khasra) is shown as a source property. It replaces the earlier uq-keyed source, whose per-cell piece joins were too slow in browsers.
Found through ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals (github.com/ramSeraph/indian_cadastrals), which lists HSAC as an original source; the map is read live from HSAC.
The service answers browsers directly (CORS allows this site); no relay is used.
